subject: Outstanding invoice + VAT paperwork blocking payment — request for exec bridge
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@pinefield.health>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice INV-202703 overdue — next steps and paperwork needed

Hi Marta,

Following up on invoice INV-202703 (issued 2027-02-28, net 30) — the outstanding balance of $76,432 is now past due. We received a note from your team that payment is delayed due to a VAT reverse-charge validation request. To unblock payment we need the completed VAT-support-request-form and either: a PO number referencing INV-202703 or confirmation of the reverse-charge registration (local VAT ID + CSV).

I've attached the invoice and the short VAT form for your accounts team. If Pinefield prefers a short payment schedule, we can set a two-part plan (50% now, remainder 30 days) — we can draft a simple agreement for signature.

Please confirm by EOD Wed 14 Apr whether you can provide the VAT docs or prefer the payment schedule. If neither are possible, we will escalate to leadership for a quick executive touchpoint to avoid longer dunning sequences.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior AR Specialist
Redwood Inference
Attachment: INV-202703_Pinefield.pdf (invoice PDF)
Attachment: VAT-support-request-form.pdf (form)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@pinefield.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@pinefield.health>, accounts@pinefield.health
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-202703 overdue — next steps and paperwork needed

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — we received this internally. The delay is on our side: our finance / tax team is validating whether the reverse-charge applies for this vendor and jurisdiction. They have asked for the invoice with line-level VAT breakdown and Redwood's confirmation of tax residency for the supplying entity. I can provide the PO but only once the tax team signs off.

I uploaded the VAT questions to our tracker and copied Oliver who manages tax at Pinefield. ETA from our tax team is end of next week (21 Apr). We'd like to avoid leadership escalation — can you hold off dunning until 21 Apr and confirm that a PO will be issued once tax is validated?

Best,
Marta
Finance Operations Manager
Pinefield Health

Marissa / Laura,

Thanks for the heads up and Marta for the update. Two quick notes:
1) We should accept holding off formal collections until 21 Apr, but I want an explicit written milestone and a contact in Pinefield tax (Oliver) on the chain for accountability.
2) If we still haven't received the VAT validation or PO by 21 Apr, escalate to me and I'll coordinate an exec bridge with Pinefield's CFO; I'd rather that be a short 20-minute call than let this turn into a legal collections route.

Marissa — please draft a one-paragraph payment-agreement-draft that says: 50% payable within 7 days of PO issuance/validation, remainder within 30 days. Copy Aditya (sales leadership) on the draft for approval of any concessions. Also attach the line-level VAT breakout we have on file.

I'll hold on formal dunning for now and mark the account 'pending-tax-validation'.

- Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Marissa

Apologies for the delay — our tax lead was out last week and review slipped. Quick update: we have the line-level VAT and the payment agreement looks fine. However, our procurement team requires executive confirmation of contract-level acceptance for any payment plan >30 days. I'll escalate internally but expect we can provide a PO if Redwood's Head of Sales signs off on the short schedule.

If Redwood can provide a one-page exec confirmation (from Sales leadership) that the payment plan is operationally acceptable, I can get a PO issued within 48 hours. Otherwise procurement wants the original terms and immediate full payment.

Oliver
Senior Tax & Procurement Lead
Pinefield Health
